headlines.title: Fatal crash shuts down westbound Bay Bridge lanes for 3 hours early Sunday
headlines.description: The California Highway Patrol is investigating a fatal collision that shut down all westbound lanes of Interstate 80 on the San Francisco-Oakland Bay Bridge for three hours early Sunday. According to CHP logs, the crash occurred east of Yerba Buena Island and involved at least a gray Audi sedan and a Hyundai Palisade SUV. The Palisade reportedly sustained major front-end damage, and both vehicles required tow trucks. All westbound lanes were shut down by about 3:49 a.m., prompting a SigAlert and forcing traffic to divert onto the Treasure Island/Yerba Buena Island off-ramp. The CHP also requested a hard closure beginning near the bridge’s self-anchored suspension tower. All westbound lanes reopened around 6:49 a.m.
